title: Official F1® Arcade Lusail Watch Party
description:
Experience all the race day energy at F1® Arcade.

TIMINGS:

Venue opens: 10am (get in early to soak up the atmosphere)

  • Watch Party starts: 3pm
  • Race starts: 4pm
  • Open sim racing: 3pm - 6pm

GENERAL ADMISSION

Your ticket includes open sim racing from one hour before lights out until the end of the Watch Party. Between the race action, jump into the driver’s seat for head-to-head battles on track, and take on our complimentary mini-games, including React and Lights Out.

Enjoy a DJ throughout the day and a live host during the Watch Party, plus quizzes and competitions, including our fastest-lap challenge to keep the energy high from start to finish.

After each sim race, please be considerate of other guests to ensure everyone gets a chance to race.

PLEASE NOTE SEATING IS NOT GUARANTEED AND IS ON A FIRST COME FIRST SERVED BASIS.

CLUB ENCLOSURE 

Upgrade your Watch Party experience with our Club Enclosure ticket, our exclusive, semi-private area where you’ll be the centre of the action in premium seats.

What’s included:

Allocated seat in our exclusive Club Enclosure area

Selection of sharers and a choice of main; Chicken, Beef or Plant Burger, or Caesar/Superbowl Salad 4 House Drinks (House Beer, Wine, Mocktails, Soft Drinks).
address: F1 Arcade Birmingham, 2 Chamberlain Square, Birmingham, B3 3AX

title: New Year's Eve Party
description:
Skip the usual countdown and celebrate New Year's Eve with an evening of racing, cocktails, great food and live entertainment.

Whether you're battling friends on the track, catching up over drinks or dancing your way into the New Year, we've got everything you need for an unforgettable night.

YOUR NEW YEAR'S EVE EXPERIENCE

TABLE TICKET

Includes:

RESERVED TABLE SEATING

If members of your group book separately, please let the venue know so we can seat you together. To make the most of the space available, smaller groups may share a table with another party.

SIM RACING

Take on friends and family in our full-motion racing simulators throughout the night.

FOOD & DRINK CREDIT

Enjoy a welcome cocktail or alcohol-free alternative on arrival, plus £25 food and drink credit to spend throughout the evening.

MIDNIGHT TOAST

Raise a glass with a champagne toast at midnight.

LIVE ENTERTAINMENT

Enjoy live music, DJs and dancing through to the early hours.

GENERAL ADMISSION

Includes:

OPEN SIM RACING

Take on friends and family in our full-motion racing simulators throughout the night.

MIDNIGHT TOAST

Celebrate the New Year with a glass of bubbles at midnight.

LIVE ENTERTAINMENT

Live music, DJs and dancing through to the early hours.

Please note: Reserved seating is not included with General Admission tickets.
address: F1 Arcade Birmingham, 2 Chamberlain Square, Birmingham, B3 3AX

title: Sprint Social
description:
Zero chill, 100% thrill.

Three hours of racing, food, drinks and competition. Every other Tuesday in Birmingham/London, 6pm–9pm.

Warm up on free-play, then go head-to-head in a hosted team tournament. Top drivers battle it out in the finale before the sims reopen for one last free-play race.

TIMINGS

Check-in with reception by 5:45pm.

Tournament starts 6pm

WHAT'S INCLUDED

£25 per person.

Welcome drink: Heineken® or Heineken® 0.0 or soft drinks.

Sharing-style flatbreads (GF & vegan on request).

Free-play racing before and after the tournament.

90-minute hosted tournament.

All guests must be 18+

FROM ROOKIE TO ELITE

Five skill levels, one grid. Come to compete, come for the social side however you race, there's a place for you.

Sprint Social T&C
address: F1 Arcade Birmingham, 2 Chamberlain Square, Birmingham, B3 3AX
